verdict.rationale: Skyfire ships an MCP server that lets any agent discover sellers, mint kya/pay tokens, and complete checkout (skyfire-docs-6, skyfire-docs-31, skyfire-supp-9), which is the technical rail that a buyer-agent running inside an MCP-capable chat surface could use to purchase from a merchant. However, the evidence never names or documents specific integration/listing with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot as consumer chat surfaces — it only describes a generic MCP endpoint and Playground/API flows aimed at developers building agents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Skyfire being usable/available inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot surfaces, any app-store/plugin listing, and independent confirmation of an end-user completing an in-chat purchase via one of these named assistants.
